name: Brooklyn Greenways
description: The association's oldest chapter, with plots on rooftops, vacant lots and a former rail yard.

name: Twin Cities Growers
description: Cold-climate growers who swap season-extension tricks and run the region's biggest winter seed swap.

name: Atlanta Roots Collective
meets: Third Thursday, 6:30 pm, West End Commons
description: School gardens, church gardens and an orchard network that now covers twelve neighbourhoods.

name: Desert Bloom Phoenix
meets: Last Sunday, 8 am (before the heat), Roosevelt Row
description: Water-wise growing, shade structures and a greywater pilot run with the city.

name: Bay Commons
meets: Second Saturday, 11 am, Lakeside Garden Center
description: Urban farms, a tool library with 900 tools, and a youth program that runs all year.

name: Front Range Plots
meets: First Wednesday, 6 pm, Denver Botanic Commons
description: High-altitude growing, hail netting and a shared hoop-house program.

name: Philadelphia Lot Gardens
meets: Fourth Monday, 7 pm, Fairmount Rec Center
description: Turns vacant lots into gardens with a legal toolkit now used by six other chapters.

name: Austin Shared Harvest
description: A newer chapter focused on food pantries: last year members grew 11 tonnes for local pantries.
